brief.description: A voice-note app that turns spoken thoughts into searchable notes and action items, so useful ideas do not disappear before I act on them.
brief.problem: Spoken ideas and commitments disappear before I act on them.
brief.benefit: Turn spoken ideas into searchable notes and actionable next steps.
